attempts.text:
The cheapest plan is to make two round trips from Myagang shelter. This rescues all six people for 154 minutes of driving and no deferral penalties.

- **Where people can go:** Myagang shelter is the only designated evacuation point. Gosaikunda temple is on high ground but has not been designated, so nobody can be dropped there.
- **Roads:** The Dhunche farm–Gosaikunda temple road is unusable because of fast floodwater. The best routes are direct: Myagang–Suryagadhi (26 min) and Myagang–Gosaikunda (51 min).
- **People:**
  - Suryagadhi market: 3 injured.
  - Gosaikunda temple: 1 adult (the farmer) and 2 elderly (the couple).
- **Suryagadhi trip:** The round trip costs 52 minutes. Deferring the three injured would cost 3 × 80 = 240, so we rescue them.
- **Gosaikunda trip:** The round trip costs 102 minutes. Deferring would cost 20 + 2 × 50 = 120, so we rescue all three. Both groups fit in the four-seat car, so each needs only one trip.

<plan>
drive car1 myagang-shelter suryagadhi-market
load car1 injured 3
drive car1 suryagadhi-market myagang-shelter
unload car1 injured 3
drive car1 myagang-shelter gosaikunda-temple
load car1 adult 1
load car1 elderly 2
drive car1 gosaikunda-temple myagang-shelter
unload car1 adult 1
unload car1 elderly 2
</plan>

COST: 154
